purpose: Separate full-message repacking from explicit anchor intervention before any generator experiment.

measurement.serialization: scripts.graphrag_check.canonical_bytes on the complete two-message array; no trailing newline; same SYSTEM and user question/evidence/validation fields as scripts/graphrag_input_contract.py
measurement.runtime: tokenizers 0.22.1; no_padding/no_truncation; len(encode(text).ids), including tokenizer special tokens
measurement.limit: E5 serialized-JSON accounting is not generator tokenizer/chat framing or model context capacity.

caps.rationale: Predeclared engineering allocation: 3/4 base and 1/4 report. Not optimized or claimed sufficient from outcomes. Caps fixed for all questions/arms; no outcome-adaptive tuning.

base_packing.input: Question text and ordered original source chunks from a separately frozen candidate policy. No scorer, task labels, references, expected answer or report supplied to packer. Question ID is lineage only.
base_packing.message: Two-message array with unchanged SYSTEM; canonical user object {question: original string, evidence: selected original chunks, validation: null}.
base_packing.policy: First eight eligible candidate chunks only, original order. For each, serialize entire tentative base message and count tokens/bytes. Accept only if both base caps satisfied; otherwise record skipped-budget ID and continue within the eight. Never refill from later candidates. Never truncate or rewrite chunk fields or question.
base_packing.empty: Measure empty-evidence base first. If overhead exceeds base caps return overhead_budget_error. If no candidate fits return evidence_budget_error; preserve empty result and all skips, never label it successful evidence.
base_packing.error: Malformed candidate/identity, duplicate IDs or upstream error stays input/upstream error with no successful partial result. Reject more than eight at this interface; caller retains excluded-after-eight candidates in trace.

report_phase.selection: Freeze C evidence before validation; E must match C under the same policy and D copies exact C. A1/B/C/E carry validation:null and do not spend the reserved report allocation on extra evidence.
report_phase.report: Generate native SHACL and matched Python checks from exact selected C only, with the existing binding scope. Compact report keeps raw_conforms, results, applicable_bindings, coverage, no_bindings_status unchanged. No source lookup or recomputation to change C.
report_phase.accounting: Measure full D message directly. Also compute D count minus the corresponding C base-message count for tokens and bytes. Require full caps AND incremental caps. Do not assume separately tokenized components add linearly.
report_phase.overflow: If report increment or full D exceeds caps, mark D report_budget_error and retain full report/full serialized D artifact and counts. No check omission, report truncation, C repacking, extra retrieval or fallback to C. C and E results remain recorded.
report_phase.checker_error: Preserve validation_execution_error on D, no conformant substitute; retain C/E and exact evidence hash.
report_phase.no_checks: Raw conforms=true with zero bindings remains operational unknown; never use as positive eligibility.

comparisons.stage_1: Repack frozen existing candidate lists with anchor disabled. This isolates budget-accounting change from locator insertion; historical runs stay frozen.
comparisons.stage_2: Separate future run with same caps/candidate policy and shared explicit anchor enabled across A1/B/C/E, D exact new C. Compare paired anchor-off vs anchor-on on all 24.
comparisons.policy_gate: Each stage needs a fresh implementation/review/run manifest binding exact candidate lists, upstream algorithms, source, questions, code, contract and tokenizer hashes before execution. This contract alone does not fix or authorize candidate reconstruction or relation traversal.
comparisons.baseline_limit: Repacking changes evidence selection and is a development intervention; not a new dense model, database benefit or generator answer evaluation.

denominators.planned: All 24 consumed development questions times five arms per stage, including upstream, overhead, evidence, report and validation errors. Record unprocessed separately.
denominators.paired_analysis: Report arm-specific full denominators and paired changes. Never restrict headline comparison to all-arms-fit subset. No generation for oversized/error rows.
denominators.scoring: Any later support scorer stays offline unchanged and cannot feed packing, anchor lookup or checks. No gold repair.

required_records: exact source chunks and selected evidence hash
base and full serialized bytes/hash/token/byte counts
actual_generation_gate: Named model and pinned tokenizer/chat template or verified provider accounting
Input plus output reservation within model context under same total budget for every arm
New explicit paid scope if required; current paid calls authorized 0
Fresh reviews and source-only no-gold experiment manifest
this_cycle: Contract review and JSON/hash verification only; no packing/retrieval/model execution
next_implementation: Pure common base-message packer and report-budget accounting with boundary controls; candidate generation remains external and frozen.
